curation.lead:
Mathieu Gilbert Roger Villaume (French, born August 1976, Luxembourg resident) is a Luxembourg-based corporate-administration specialist who serves as director or managing director on at least 21 active Luxembourg entities spanning two distinct domiciliation clusters [Finding #11223][Finding #11129]. Records show Villaume's professional career spans five service-firm employers (REYL & Cie, Alter Domus, IQ-EQ, Fundcraft, and Vault Administration / Azur & Partners) and approximately 84 historical board appointments across the United Kingdom, Luxembourg, and Malta [Finding #11129][northdata.com/VILLAUME]. Trained as a lawyer at the Universite d'Avignon, Villaume currently co-founds Azur & Partners and serves as managing director of Vault Administration [Finding #11129].

Villaume's mandate portfolio bridges two Luxembourg corporate-services environments that recur in the investigation's records: 12 rue Guillaume Schneider L-2522 (the NeoTrust Fiduciary domicile that hosts SPQR Capital Holding SA and Compagnie Du Saleve SA), and 2 rue Sainte-Zithe L-2763 (the same street as Rothschild & Co Luxembourg, which hosts the three Knightsbridge Capital Partners Holding SPVs) [Finding #11223][Finding #11219]. Records indicate Villaume served as a director of SPQR Capital Holding SA from 1 March 2016 to 7 February 2018, alongside Alessandro Benedetti (chair) and Bertrand G. des Pallieres [Finding #11215]; analysis of the appointment dates indicates the three directors were installed simultaneously [Finding #11226]. He directs Compagnie Du Saleve SA (Luxembourg RCS B223232) since 23 March 2018, an entity wholly owned by Five Arrows AutoBench Holding Sarl, the Rothschild & Co Five Arrows private-equity vehicle [Finding #11211][Finding #11188].

From 2023 Villaume serves as sole director of Knightsbridge Capital Partners Holding I, II, and III SA (Luxembourg RCS B279238, B280404, B281581) and from 1 July 2024 as Co-Designated Member of Asherco LLP (UK Companies House OC379532), succeeding a chain of British Virgin Islands corporate members and Israeli-resident director Dotan Moshe [Finding #11219][Finding #11129]. Analysis of Villaume's cross-mandate continuity describes him as the only natural-person edge linking the SPQR-era and Asherco-era corporate vehicles associated with Benedetti and des Pallieres, a pattern characterised in the investigation's records as an eight-year operational tenure of a single Luxembourg-based fiduciary professional across sequential corporate vehicles [Finding #11162].
curation.system_role: Villaume is an infrastructure node — a single Luxembourg-based corporate-administration professional whose mandate portfolio bridges two distinct Luxembourg domiciliation environments (12 rue Guillaume Schneider and 2 rue Sainte-Zithe) and provides natural-person continuity across sequential corporate vehicles in the Wind Hellas creditor circle and the Rothschild Five Arrows orbit.

sections.title: Career and Identity Record
sections.content:
Records show Villaume's full legal name as Mathieu Gilbert Roger Villaume, French national, born August 1976 and resident in Luxembourg [Finding #11129]. He trained as a lawyer at the Universite d'Avignon [Finding #11129]. According to the investigation's career reconstruction drawn from NorthData and Companies House filings, Villaume's professional progression moved through five corporate-services employers: Zimmer & Partners Sarl in the early 2000s, REYL & Cie's Luxembourg branch (where he served as Head of Multifamily Office for approximately eight years through 2013), Alter Domus (2013-2018, Director Head of Private Clients), IQ-EQ (2018-2020, Managing Director Head of Private Wealth Luxembourg), and Fundcraft (2020-2023, Chief Operating Officer) [Finding #11129][northdata.com/VILLAUME].

Since 2023 Villaume has co-founded Azur & Partners, serves as managing director of Vault Administration, and directs LOGIVER S.A. [Finding #11129]. NorthData aggregates approximately 155 director-report relationships and 84 historical appointments across the United Kingdom, Luxembourg, and Malta, with approximately 21 currently active Luxembourg mandates per the most recent registry pull [Finding #11223][northdata.com/VILLAUME]. The earliest documented mandate is SCI du Bourgneuf (France) from 15 May 2003 [Finding #11223]. Records also document Villaume as legal/judicial representative and director of REYL HOLDING (MALTA) LTD, incorporated 29 January 2015 and registered in the ICIJ Paradise Papers as node 56009779 [Finding #11129][icij-paradise-papers-56009779].

sections.title: 12 rue Guillaume Schneider Cluster
sections.content:
The first Luxembourg domiciliation cluster in which Villaume's mandates concentrate is 12 rue Guillaume Schneider L-2522, the corporate-services address operated by NeoTrust Fiduciary [Finding #11223]. Registry records show this address hosts both SPQR Capital Holding SA (Luxembourg RCS B150334) and Compagnie Du Saleve SA (Luxembourg RCS B223232), as well as approximately eleven historical Panama Papers entities including Kaupthing Bank Luxembourg SA variants [Finding #11129][Finding #11215][Finding #11211].

Records show Villaume served as a director of SPQR Capital Holding SA from 1 March 2016 to 7 February 2018, alongside chair Alessandro Benedetti and Bertrand G. des Pallieres [Finding #11215]; analysis of the appointment dates indicates the three directors were installed simultaneously on 1 March 2016 [Finding #11226]. The Luxembourg parent SPQR Capital Holding SA was liquidated on 16 March 2023 by liquidator Christian Steinmetz [Finding #11215]. Analysis of the appointment pattern indicates that the simultaneous 1 March 2016 installation followed the joint resignation of Benedetti and des Pallieres from Attali Investment Partners Ltd in December 2015 [Finding #11226][Finding #842].

From 23 March 2018 Villaume directs Compagnie Du Saleve SA, which became wholly owned by Five Arrows AutoBench Holding Sarl on 8 March 2023 [Finding #11211][Finding #11188]. Five Arrows AutoBench Holding Sarl (Luxembourg RCS B209234, originally Five Arrows White C Holding Sarl, renamed 2 December 2020) is a Rothschild Five Arrows private-equity vehicle that was itself terminated on 21 November 2024 [Finding #11213]. Examination of the 12 rue Guillaume Schneider address indicates this domiciliation is the first documented intersection between Villaume's mandate portfolio and the Rothschild & Co private-equity orbit [Finding #11129][Finding #11166].

sections.title: 2 rue Sainte-Zithe and the Knightsbridge Lux Trio
sections.content:
The second Luxembourg domiciliation cluster in which Villaume serves as sole director comprises three parallel special-purpose vehicles registered at 2 rue Sainte-Zithe L-2763: Knightsbridge Capital Partners Holding I, II, and III SA (Luxembourg RCS B279238, B280404, B281581) [Finding #11219]. All three entities were formed within a three-month window in 2023, all carry EUR 30,000 share capital, all are audited by JNP Audit Services, and all list Villaume as the sole director [Finding #11219].

According to registry records, the address 2 rue Sainte-Zithe is on the same Luxembourg street as Rothschild & Co Luxembourg's office per Rothschild & Co's own offices listing, supporting the inference that the Knightsbridge Holding SPVs are Rothschild-adjacent vehicles, though no shareholder-level Rothschild ownership is documented in the available registry data [Finding #11219]. The identical-structure pattern across three vehicles formed in close sequence is consistent with the SPV-per-investment template typical of private-equity deal-by-deal vehicles [Finding #11219].

Records show that the similarly named United Kingdom entity Knightsbridge Capital Partners Ltd (Companies House 11314526, 33 St James's Square London) was dissolved on 26 January 2021 and had no officer overlap with Villaume, des Pallieres, Benedetti, or the broader Wind Hellas / SPQR / Compagnie Du Saleve cluster [Finding #11217]. The investigation's records note that the only nominal connection between the United Kingdom Knightsbridge entity and the Luxembourg Knightsbridge Holding trio is the shared name [Finding #11217].

sections.title: Asherco LLP and the United Kingdom Bridge
sections.content:
From 1 July 2024 Villaume serves as a Co-Designated Member of Asherco LLP (UK Companies House OC379532), the United Kingdom limited liability partnership in which Alessandro Benedetti has been a member since the entity's formation in October 2012 [Finding #11129][Finding #842]. Records indicate Villaume succeeded a chain of British Virgin Islands corporate members and Israeli-resident director Dotan Moshe in this role [Finding #11129][Finding #843].

Companies House filings show Asherco LLP previously included two former BVI corporate members at the same Road Town, Tortola registered-agent address: Youngstown Investments Group Ltd (BVI 1688567, member November 2014 to November 2021) and SATSU Finance Ltd (BVI 1583501, member November 2021 to March 2023) [Finding #843]. Israeli national Dotan Moshe (Israeli, born February 1972) served as a member from March 2023 to July 2024 before Villaume's appointment [Finding #843]. Cross-reference of Villaume's SPQR director tenure (2016-2018) and his Asherco membership (2024-present) suggests Villaume is the only natural-person continuity between the SPQR-era and Asherco-era United Kingdom-Geneva corporate vehicles associated with Benedetti and des Pallieres, an analysis described in the investigation's records as an eight-year operational tenure of a single Luxembourg-based fiduciary professional [Finding #11162].

sections.title: Director-for-Hire Pattern Across 21+ Mandates
sections.content:
Records indicate that Villaume's role across the 21-plus active Luxembourg mandates is most parsimoniously characterised as that of a professional corporate-administration specialist providing director services on a fee-for-service or relationship-based basis, rather than as a beneficial owner or directing mind of the underlying entities [Finding #11129][Finding #11223]. The investigation's records list the following Luxembourg mandates beyond the SPQR, Compagnie Du Saleve, and Knightsbridge Holding entities: Anfield Capital, BlockTrust, Brandbull International, Cement Fund / GP, Chross, Cinchona, Codusa, ESI Group, HBB, JD Invest, Mosaic Real Estate Finance, Riif Finance, SAE Management, Ter 2 Base, and Viratom SPF [Finding #11223]. Several of these entities were terminated or liquidated during 2024 and 2025, including Anfield, Cement Fund / GP, Ter 2 Base, and BlockTrust [Finding #11223].

Analysis of Villaume's mandate-portability across five service-firm employers (REYL & Cie, Alter Domus, IQ-EQ, Fundcraft, and Vault Administration / Azur & Partners) records that the pattern of carrying client mandates across employer transitions is consistent with a personal-relationship fiduciary role rather than passive nominee service [Finding #11129][Finding #11166]. The investigation's records explicitly correct an earlier interpretation that conflated Villaume with a domiciliation agent: NeoTrust Fiduciary is the corporate-services firm operating the 12 rue Guillaume Schneider domicile, and Villaume is a person who serves as director on entities at that address [Finding #11223]. No Tahnoon, OneIM, Mubadala, or Epstein-network entity overlap is documented in Villaume's mandate portfolio according to the investigation's negative-search records [Finding #11129].

sections.title: Significance to the Investigation
sections.content:
According to the investigation's structural analysis, Villaume's significance is that of an infrastructure node rather than a principal actor [Finding #11166]. Cross-reference of his mandate portfolio indicates two structurally distinct clusters that recur in the broader investigation share a single natural-person fiduciary edge: the Wind Hellas / SPQR / Compagnie Du Saleve cluster at 12 rue Guillaume Schneider, which connects to Alessandro Benedetti, Bertrand G. des Pallieres, and Rajeev Misra via the SoftBank-caper litigation record, and the Knightsbridge Holding trio at 2 rue Sainte-Zithe, on the same street as Rothschild & Co Luxembourg [Finding #11166][Finding #11219].

Examination of Villaume's appointment to Asherco LLP in July 2024 indicates the role was taken after the publication of Wall Street Journal reporting on Benedetti and des Pallieres and after the United Kingdom Economic Crime and Corporate Transparency Acts of 2022 and 2023 took effect, supporting the interpretation that Villaume accepted the role on full information [Finding #11129]. The investigation's records assess the most parsimonious read as that of a high-trust personal fiduciary, materially more than a rota-nominee but not the directing mind, with an estimated 80 percent probability of witting operational housekeeper status and a 5-10 percent estimated probability of beneficial-owner status [Finding #11129].

Records indicate a separate but parallel Rothschild-orbit anchor in the broader investigation through Ian Charles Domaille (Non-Executive Director of Vallares Plc, the 2011 Nathaniel Rothschild-Tony Hayward oil and gas SPAC) and his director role at Bremner Capital UK Ltd, indicating that the investigation has documented two independent Rothschild-orbit corporate-administration anchors into the wider 15-actor system [Finding #11169].

Did Villaume's transition from Fundcraft (Chief Operating Officer through 2023) to co-founding Azur & Partners and managing Vault Administration coincide with the simultaneous 2023 formation of the three Knightsbridge Capital Partners Holding SPVs at 2 rue Sainte-Zithe, and if so what was the structural reason for the new platform?
